note: lap 10 screen rule, fixed at gate screen-specs (before any screen build). Per request R: Q = mean over the k builds of R-cc-p of the pass fractions on R-cc-p and on R-cx-p, averaged (both families' scenarios weigh the same); a set a build has no results for counts 0; scenarios listed in screen-errors.json (written at gate main under the errors rule, approved by the owner) are left out. R is in the band when floorPct <= Q < ceilingPct. Up to maxRequests requests in the band go on to the main runs, lowest Q first; ties: the order below. The screen's drafts and builds are never used in the main analysis. Names resolve to the last redraft. Rules: laps/lap-10/runbook.md.
